units.source_text: ①《付丧神记》：日本定河时代的连环画书，共二卷。

en.t: Tsukumogami ki: an illustrated storybook from Japan's Jokyo era, in two volumes.

units.source_text: 描写不用的旧家具，年长日久，化为妖精，兴妖作怪的故事。

en.t: It tells the story of old, unused furniture that, after many long years, turns into spirits and causes strange disturbances.
